ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2023 entering class (ADM2023), via College Navigator

ipeds_ef.title: IPEDS Fall Enrollment 2023 (EF2023A): undergraduate total and U.S. nonresident headcount

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS (fall 2023 entering class): 3,318 applied, 3,224 admitted, 402 enrolled. No Common Data Set was found for Bethel (TN), so GPA and international applicant/admit counts are not available. SAT percentiles rest on only 101 submitters. Newer College Navigator figures (fall 2024) differ sharply: 1,486 applicants, about 60% admitted (rounded %), ACT 15/18/21, SAT ERW 410/460/570, SAT Math 420/460/550; 2,674 undergraduates (used for enrollment here). Test optional with weighted GPA 2.25 or above.
